poc_summary:
POC highlights and technical asks:
- Workload: document-search + support-agent for product docs (~3M docs).
- Targets: conversational latency p95 <= 200ms (strict for chat), sustained throughput target 40-80 qps across shards, burst to 120 qps.
- Observed (Hosted POC): p50 ~60-90ms (small models), p95 ~120-420ms depending on model size; batching & KV prefix caching reduced cost ~22-30%.
- Model preference: open-family (Llama2-like) or Redwood-verified open variants; prefer int8/4 quantization if quality preserved. Need fallbacks to smaller variant for cost-sensitive routes.
- Routing/fallback: want region-aware routing (EU users -> EU region), cost-tier routing (prod traffic -> dedicated pool, non-prod -> hosted).
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, audit logs, and KMS integration for key control. DPA required for EU residency.
- Legal/procurement asks: MSA redlines on indemnity & liability, explicit SLA language (p99 vs p95 discussion), termination for convenience on reserved capacity, and DPA with clear data handling/residency clauses.
